title: Crash in latest master with new semantics analyzer

labels.name: topic-plugins
labels.description: The plugin API and ideas for new plugins

labels.name: semantic-analyzer
labels.description: Problems that happen during semantic analysis

body:
As requested on #6960, I'm sharing the trace from the crash of the new semantics analyzer. 

It crashes in directory with just 1 file (test.py):

```
import dataclasses


@dataclasses.dataclass(frozen=True)
class Test():
    def __init__(self, **kwargs) -> None:
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
```
